description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's 'skip-worktree' feature. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and assertions to verify the behavior of updating the index with the skip-worktree bit and related commands.

methods.name: test_set_index_version
methods.description: Sets the GIT_INDEX_VERSION environment variable to specify the index version for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and compares output to expected results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares command output with expected output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script execution.
